units: meters; origin map center; +x east, +y north, z up. Unreal X = y*100, Y = x*100, Z = z*100; Unreal yaw = 90 - yaw_json (see HANDOFF_Cascade.md)

map.name: Cascade
map.symmetry: 180-degree rotation (point symmetry); NOT a mirror any more: the NW/SE nodes are high, NE/SW low, N/S terminals mid
map.players: 6v6 PvP; PvE waves from the same layout

decks.name: Ground
decks.note: ring road, E/W arms, base rooms and the two LOW nodes (NE, SW); stair/dais footprints cut out. The N/S arm stair zones are cut out of the ring

decks.name: NorthSouthArmsAndTerminals
decks.note: z 3: the outer end of both N/S arms (y 55 to 57.5) and the T terminals; the arm is z 0 from the ring to the ArmStair (y 49 to 55)

decks.name: HighNodes
decks.note: the NW and SE nodes at z 5, above the citadel platform (z 3); node dais cut out

decks.name: CitadelHallFloor
decks.note: z 3 hall floor (r 18.75 clear) on the solid plinth (r 22.5, z 0 to 3); the hall wall is r 18.75 to 22.5

decks.name: Balcony
decks.note: z 5 top, 1 m thick (underside z 4), r 22.5 to 28.75: wider than the platform; four segments between the hub stairs and outside the roofed ring tunnels

decks.name: NodeDaisLow
decks.note: 1 m step on the NE and SW nodes (z 0 -> 1)

decks.name: NodeDaisHigh

platform.note: solid plinth; the hall floor is its top (z 3)

hall.note: 37.5 m across clear (r 18.75), 8 m high; a 3.75 m thick outer wall (r 18.75 to 22.5)

column.note: blocks the E-W and N-S axes through the doors: no spawn-to-spawn sightline

balcony.note: wider than the platform (r 28.75 vs 22.5): a cantilevered walkway over the inner ring lane, reached by stairs inside the hall; not built inside the roofed ring tunnels or over the hub stairs

citadel.note: the building rises from the platform: a 45 m wide cylinder to z 14, then tapers to a spire at z 40. It blocks the high nodes' view across the map.

pve.note: WaveManager spawns away from the player. PvE: player + 2 teammates start in the west base; east base is the last spawn group. Swarm come over the node bridges (the two high nodes at z 5 look down on the ring), Soldiers hold the terminals, Tanks walk the N/S arms.

nav.note: one volume over the whole footprint; the chasm has no walkable geometry. Needs the stairs, spiral ramps and sloped bridges (steepest: the two high radial bridges, 0.40 rise per run); agent 0.5 m radius, 35 cm step (Ring checks).
